meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Use this when the user asks to search memory, "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or wants work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速找回之前会话中解决过的问题和做法
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常想从过往对话里快速找回答案。
copy.tagline_en: Recall past solutions and how you did things before.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to dig up answers from earlier conversations.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能查询 claude-mem 的跨会话记忆库:先用 search 列出带 ID 的历史条目索引,再用 timeline 看某条前后的上下文,最后只对挑中的 ID 用 get_observations 取完整详情,避免直接拉全部内容。
howto.when: 当你问起以前会话里的事,比如「这个问题我们是不是已经修过了」「上次 X 是怎么做的」,或需要之前会话留下的成果时会触发。

say.text: 在记忆里搜一下 JWT 认证相关的记录
say.note: 先返回带 ID 的索引表,不拉全文

say.text: 上次这个登录 bug 是怎么修的?
say.note: 可用 timeline 展开该条前后的上下文

say.text: 把 #11131 和 #10942 的完整详情取出来

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can search claude-mem's cross-session memory: search lists past entries with IDs, timeline shows context around one entry, and get_observations fetches full details only for the chosen IDs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about previous sessions, e.g. "did we already solve this?" or "how did we do X last time?", or need work left from earlier sessions.

say_en.text: Search memory for the JWT authentication records
say_en.note: Returns an index table with IDs first

say_en.text: How did we fix this login bug last time?
say_en.note: timeline can expand context around that entry

say_en.text: Fetch the full details for #11131 and #10942
